{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-la-e","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"c8ad48801f62254dbc46073193522c9b5191ed416bb6881bb7c382865fdc9798","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-la-class-std:lineage:46","source_registry_sha256":"8fb2294cb50570a3a0fabb25acba3418dba999eb7dd305cc58b73fdf38975613","source_liveness_sha256":"1105a92b5841d065519de4b7fbea05111880de6d2bb8804066a972d19c63b5a0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way","heading":"Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"# Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way

FACT_ID: sec11-F01 | anchor: A01
Obey traffic laws and lawful police directions while operating on streets or highways. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F02 | anchor: A01
When an officer signals a stop, remain calm and pull over safely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F03 | anchor: A01
Be ready to present a driver’s license, vehicle registration and current insurance evidence during a traffic stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F04 | anchor: A01
Remain inside the vehicle unless the officer directs otherwise and keep hands visible. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F05 | anchor: A01
The guide permits asking an officer in an unmarked vehicle and without a uniform for identification. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F06 | anchor: A01
Follow signs, signals and pavement controls. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F07 | anchor: A01
When an intersection signal is not working, treat the intersection as an all-way stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F08 | anchor: A01
A driver must maintain reasonable, proper control of the vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F09 | anchor: A01
Posted speed limits describe ideal conditions rather than a safe speed for every situation. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0091]

FACT_ID: sec11-F10 | anchor: A02
Reduce speed when wet or icy pavement, poor visibility or heavy traffic makes the posted speed unsafe. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F11 | anchor: A02
Check the speedometer because perceived speed can be misleading after leaving a fast multilane road. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F12 | anchor: A02
The general speed rule requires a reasonable speed for traffic, location, road, light and weather conditions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F13 | anchor: A02
Do not exceed a posted maximum speed or travel below a posted minimum. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F14 | anchor: A02
Do not drive so slowly that traffic is obstructed. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F15 | anchor: A02
Slow in school and playground areas and at a school crossing when children are present. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F16 | anchor: A02
Racing, speed contests and speed exhibitions on public roads are unlawful in the guide. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F17 | anchor: A02
Do not cross the median or barrier of a divided highway except at an approved crossover. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F18 | anchor: A02
Before changing lanes, check mirrors, check over the shoulder, look for others entering that lane and signal. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec11-F19 | anchor: A03
Never make a hurried, unsafe lane change just to avoid missing a turn or exit. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F20 | anchor: A03
If there is no safe gap for a lane change, wait rather than force entry into the lane. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F21 | anchor: A03
Let a faster vehicle in the intended lane pass before moving into its path. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F22 | anchor: A03
The guide prohibits changing lanes while approaching or traveling through an intersection. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F23 | anchor: A03
Stop at least thirty feet from a school bus stopped for children boarding or leaving, except where a stated roadway exception applies. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F24 | anchor: A03
A bus’s yellow warning lamps announce an approaching stop; red lamps and the stop arm activate when it stops. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F25 | anchor: A03
For a stopped school bus, drivers normally stop whether approaching it or traveling behind it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F26 | anchor: A03
A bus completely outside the roadway in a loading zone where pedestrians cannot cross the road is a stated stopping exception. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F27 | anchor: A03
A driver on the opposite roadway need not stop when an impassable ditch, median or barrier separates it from the stopped bus. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0093]

FACT_ID: sec11-F28 | anchor: A04
The guide also exempts opposite-direction traffic on four- or five-lane roads separated by a dedicated two-way left-turn lane from stopping for the bus. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F29 | anchor: A04
On a four-lane roadway without a separating barrier or a stated turn-lane exception, stop for the school bus. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F30 | anchor: A04
A road with one lane each way and a middle two-way left-turn lane still requires both directions to stop for the school bus. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F31 | anchor: A04
At an intersection, slow and prepare to stop because having priority does not guarantee safety. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F32 | anchor: A04
Prepare a turn early, scan surrounding traffic, signal and select the appropriate lane before turning. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0094]

FACT_ID: sec11-F33 | anchor: A04
The guide requires signaling and occupying the proper lane at least one hundred feet before a turn. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0094]
